title: usage-event (Redis Stream payload)
description: Asynchronous usage event emitted by Gateway (M1) to Redis Stream 'usage-events' (published as the 'payload' field) for billable provider calls with trustworthy usage, consumed by Worker (M3) for cost calculation and aggregations.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version number, fixed at integer 1 for this contract version.

eventId.description: UUID acting as a stable idempotency key for one billable provider call; reused unchanged across Redis publication retries.

occurredAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp indicating when the billable provider call occurred; must be serialized in UTC with a trailing 'Z' (e.g., via Date.toISOString()).

provider.description: Open, non-empty canonical identifier for the LLM provider (e.g., 'openai', 'anthropic', 'gemini', 'ollama').

model.description: Effective provider model ID used for the call (e.g., 'gpt-4o', 'claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022').

usage.description: Raw trustworthy token usage reported by the provider. Do not emit usage events if trustworthy usage is unknown or unavailable.

inputTokens.description: Non-negative safe integer count of input/prompt tokens.

outputTokens.description: Non-negative safe integer count of output/completion tokens. A value of 0 is valid only when trustworthy provider usage explicitly reports zero; unknown usage must never be substituted with zero.

requestId.description: Gateway correlation ID for end-to-end tracing and debugging.
